# Asset credits

All files below are CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); credit is given as a courtesy.
Licence verified at https://polyhaven.com/license ("Our assets are all licensed as CC0").
Each was downloaded as a 1k JPG from Poly Haven and recompressed (diffuse q80, OpenGL normal q88; normals kept for ground, mud and rock only).

| File | Source asset | Author | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| tex/ground.jpg, tex/ground_n.jpg | Forest Ground 01, https://polyhaven.com/a/forrest_ground_01 | Rob Tuytel | CC0 |
| tex/mud.jpg, tex/mud_n.jpg | Brown Mud 02, https://polyhaven.com/a/brown_mud_02 | Rob Tuytel | CC0 |
| tex/rock.jpg, tex/rock_n.jpg | Mossy Rock, https://polyhaven.com/a/mossy_rock | Rob Tuytel | CC0 |
| tex/bark.jpg | Metasequoia Bark, https://polyhaven.com/a/metasequoia_bark | Charlotte Baglioni | CC0 |
| tex/concrete.jpg | Concrete Wall 006, https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_wall_006 | Dario Barresi, Charlotte Baglioni | CC0 |

Phones (low tier) load only the diffuse maps, downscaled to 512 px in the browser.
If any file fails to load, the procedural canvas textures are used instead.
